check: Billing lines with no cost on the material master
action: A missing standard cost prices at margin over zero. Get it maintained before the line is repriced.
A duplicate doubles the customer's apparent volume and can move it into a better discount tier. Deduplicate on document and item.

check: Unit of measure that does not match the material master
action: A case billed as an each is a price out by the pack size, and it reads as a bargain rather than as an error.

check: Billing lines with no condition record, so no list price
action: Without a condition record there is no list price to measure the discount against, so the line cannot enter the waterfall.

check: Net value that does not equal quantity times net price
action: The extract's own arithmetic disagrees. Until it is reconciled, neither number can be used.

check: Quantities that are zero or negative outside a credit note
action: A zero-quantity line divides by zero in every per-unit measure.

check: Sellable rates outside anything a distribution centre produces
action: A sellable rate above 1.0 ships more units than were received, and a very low one triples the cost. Both are keying errors.

check: Lines invoiced below the material's standard cost
action: Not always an error -- clearance and contractual loss-leaders exist -- but every one of these should be somebody's decision.

check: Customers on a billing line that the customer master has never heard of
action: An orphan account cannot be segmented, so its margin lands in no cut of the book and quietly disappears.

check: Condition records not touched in over a year
action: A price nobody has reviewed in a year, in a market whose input index moved. Put it on the review list.

check: Billing documents posted after the extract date
action: A future posting date is a test document or a keying error, and it lands in a period that has already been reported.

check: Customer master rows with no sales district
action: An account with no district cannot be reported regionally or assigned to a rep.
